intent: Travel a country mile from village outskirts through fields, a working farm, a river bridge and a distant rolling lane. Expert redesign: travelling farm machinery and crossing signals.

sections.name: The village outskirts
sections.lesson: Pass the last village fences. Let the cutter finish its sweep before crossing.
